verdict.rationale: Thoropass ships several built-in AI features users can delegate tasks to: the AI Helpbot answers support questions inside the app (docs-45, docs-46), First Pass AI pre-screens evidence automatically (docs-11, docs-23, docs-43), and GenAI-based autofill handles questionnaire completion (docs-44). These are genuine built-in agentic/automation features rather than a single general-purpose assistant. Missing for 10: evidence of a unified conversational assistant that can take broad, arbitrary actions across the platform (the MCP capability is for external AI clients, not a built-in assistant), and independent/hands-on validation of these AI features' reliability.
